corrections.semantics: A pullback touch is satisfied when low <= the 24h entry EMA on any of the twelve completed bars preceding the recovery bar.
The 0.75 ATR contraction ratio is evaluated using ATR and its 168h reference from the completed bar before the breakout bar.
Daily cross-sectional ordering is frozen first; hourly trend, entry-quality and cost filters are then applied in rank order until frozen top-K breadth is filled.
Daily ranking refresh does not erase the day's ranking because the market gate is OFF at 00:00; the frozen market gate is evaluated at each hourly entry decision.
Thesis invalidation and maximum-holding signals formed on a completed bar execute at the next eligible bar open.
The stop active during a bar is known before that bar; high/ATR from the current bar may tighten the trail only for the next bar.
If a bar opens below an active long protective stop, the fill is the bar open rather than the stale stop price.

explicit_nonchanges: hourly ATR remains the frozen cost-hurdle numerator
top-K remains 2 or 3 exactly as frozen
performance_repairs: Collapse twelve repeated feature builds into two immutable feature stores keyed by the only two distinct feature signatures.
Cache six daily ranking streams: two feature signatures by three PIT universes.
Precompute thirty-six variant/universe candidate plans for both cost multipliers before portfolio execution.
Remove pandas DataFrame construction and Series.to_dict calls from the portfolio hot loop.
Keep 1,512 full raw run artifacts local and hash-addressed; commit only compact summaries and the evidence hash manifest.
Use atomic run checkpoints so interruption can resume without recomputing completed runs.
